strings.long_src: It's connected to the Snatchers.

strings.en: Мне он как-то ни к чему.
strings.long_src: Never had much use for it myself.
What's that for in this cold?
Photo

strings.en: Бедняга Гибсон. Он был ещё молод.
strings.en_src: Poor Gibson. He was still young.

strings.long_src: Who's that? Never seen him.
What are you doing with that?

strings.en_src: We have the information.￥No need to pay.
strings.long_src: We have the information we need.￥There's no need to pay.
That's enough. No need for more.

strings.en_src: Heh, much obliged.￥You'll make a fine JUNKER.
strings.long_src: Heh, thanks for your business.￥You'll make a fine JUNKER.
strings.long: Хе, приятно иметь дело. Из тебя￥выйдет отличный ДЖАНКЕР.

strings.long_src: Heh, thanks for your business.

strings.en_src: Spend without cause and they'll￥call it wasted taxes!
strings.long_src: Keep throwing money away and they'll￥accuse us of wasting taxes again!
strings.long: Будешь так сорить деньгами - нас￥опять обвинят в растрате налогов!

strings.en: С ним важно, когда платить. Иначе он￥будет только тянуть из тебя деньги.
strings.en_src: With these things it's all￥in when you pay.￥Or you get bled dry.
strings.long_src: Timing matters when you pay him.￥Otherwise, he'll just keep taking￥your money.

strings.en_src: I think you should show your JUNKER￥ID first.

strings.en: Ладно, я ухожу! Это смешно. Нет у￥меня на это времени!
strings.en_src: Fine... I'm off. Ridiculous!!￥Who has time for this!
strings.long_src: Fine, I'm leaving! This is￥ridiculous. I haven't got time for￥this!
Keep fooling around and you'll make￥me angry!
Look, a street fortune-teller.

strings.en: Гадалка. Людям всегда нужно во￥что-то верить.
strings.en_src: A teller...￥People always cling to something.
strings.long_src: A fortune-teller. People always need￥something to believe in.
What's this retinal fortune-telling￥you keep mentioning?
strings.long: Что за гадание по сетчатке, о￥котором ты всё твердишь?

strings.long_src: They read your retinal pattern to￥predict your future.

strings.en: Рисунок сосудов на сетчатке у￥каждого человека уникален.
strings.en_src: The pattern of blood vessels on the￥retina is unique to each person.

strings.en: Эти рисунки классифицируют и по ним￥гадают, как по ладони.
strings.en_src: The patterns are classed like￥palmistry, and your fortune￥read off them.
strings.long_src: They classify those patterns to￥predict your fortune, much like palm￥reading.
My future in my retina, huh?

strings.en_src: Why not have yours read, Gillian?
strings.long_src: Why don't you get a reading,￥Gillian?

strings.en_src: Hold on. Show me your JUNKER ID￥first.
Show the JUNKER ID or I'm off!!
strings.long_src: Show me your JUNKER ID or I'm￥leaving!

strings.en_src: This ID confirms all your authority￥as a JUNKER. Keep it safe.
strings.long: Удостоверение, подтверждающее все￥твои полномочия ДЖАНКЕРа. Береги￥его.

strings.en_src: The money issued to you by JUNKER.

strings.en: Записка Гибсона подсказывает, где￥его данные о слабости снатчеров.
strings.en_src: Gibson's memo on where the￥computer data on the Snatcher￥weakness is kept.
strings.long_src: Gibson's note tells us where to find￥his computer data on the Snatchers'￥weakness.

strings.en_src: The key to Gibson's desk drawer.
The chess piece Gibson was carrying.
The chess piece we found in Gibson's￥coat.

strings.long_src: The disk containing the Snatchers'￥weakness.

strings.en: Солнцезащитный крем снатчеров, если￥Гибсон был прав.
strings.en_src: Sunscreen used by the Snatchers, if￥Gibson was right.
And we confirmed it at Joy Division.

strings.en: Обычный солнцезащитный крем. На￥наклейке логотип магазина.
strings.en_src: Plain sunblock.￥The seal carries the logo of the￥shop it came from.
strings.long_src: Ordinary sunscreen. The sticker has￥the logo of the shop that sold it.

strings.en_src: A costume mask bought at Joy￥Division.
A photo of Jean Jack Gibson.
A montage built from a￥witness account.
strings.long_src: A composite portrait based on a￥witness's description.

strings.en: Встроенный чип хранит все твои￥данные, Гиллиан.
strings.en_src: Its built-in chip stores all your￥data, Gillian.
Case expenses are covered￥as work requires.
strings.long_src: In principle, there's no limit on￥expenses necessary for the￥investigation.
strings.long: В принципе, расходы на нужды￥расследования не ограничены.

strings.en_src: The candy Jean handed out￥to the orphans.
strings.long_src: The candy Jean gave to the children￥at the orphanage.
strings.long: Леденцы, которые Жан раздавал детям￥в приюте.

strings.long_src: It's on ordinary paper. Definitely￥Jean's handwriting.
The key to Gibson's desk in the￥Squad room.
strings.long: Ключ от стола Гибсона в комнате￥отдела.

strings.en: Что он открывает? Разве такими￥ключами ещё пользуются?
strings.en_src: What does it open? Does anyone still￥use keys like this?
A wooden chess piece. The queen.

strings.long_src: The disk containing Gibson's￥investigation data.

strings.en: На флаконе: "JOY DIVISION. Магазин,￥где есть всё".
strings.en_src: The bottle says, "JOY DIVISION. The￥store that has everything."
So it was sold at Joy Division.
strings.long_src: It certainly looks like Joy Division￥sold it.
strings.long: Похоже, его и правда продавали в￥"Джой Дивижн".

strings.en: Узнаем, где его купили, - может,￥найдём зацепку.
strings.en_src: Tracing where it was bought￥may give us a lead.
strings.long_src: Finding out where it was bought￥might give us a lead.

strings.en_src: A fine special-effects mask by￥Rick Bakery, all the rage now.
strings.long_src: A detailed special-effects mask by￥Rick Bakery. They're very popular￥now.
strings.long: Детальная маска со спецэффектами от￥"Рик Бейкери". Сейчас они в моде.

strings.long_src: A computer-generated 2D portrait￥made by Gaudi.

strings.en: Гибсон переставил её со своей доски￥дома. Что бы это значило?
strings.en_src: Gibson moved it from his chessboard￥at home. What could it mean?

strings.long_src: Could it be a clue to something?

strings.en: А ведь и правда похож на Ивана.
strings.en_src: He really does look like Ivan.
We can hardly blame Alphaville's￥matching system.
House? Come to think...￥I've no home either.
strings.long_src: Home. Come to think of it, I don't￥have a home to return to.
strings.long: Дом... Если подумать, мне и￥возвращаться-то некуда.

strings.en: Не унывай. Когда-нибудь ты снова￥будешь жить с Джейми.
strings.en_src: Cheer up. You'll live with Jamie￥again someday.

strings.en: Семейная жизнь ДЖАНКЕРу всё равно не￥к лицу.
strings.en_src: A family life might not suit a￥JUNKER anyway.
Why don't you give Jamie a video￥call?

strings.en: Номер её видеофона у меня тоже есть.
strings.en_src: I have her videophone number, too.

strings.en: (Номер видеофона Джейми остался у￥меня в комнате.)
Лучше не светить деньгами перед￥такими, как он.
strings.en_src: It's best not to flash money in￥front of people like him.

strings.long_src: He'll charge as much as he can get￥away with.
Did you say something?
We've still got plenty, right?

strings.en: Ты немало потратил на еду и выпивку,￥Гиллиан.
strings.en_src: It's dropped a bit, with￥your food and drink.
strings.long_src: You've spent quite a lot on eating￥and drinking, Gillian.

strings.en_src: Don't make it sound bad.￥They're expenses.
strings.long_src: Don't make it sound so bad. Those￥were necessary investigation￥expenses.
strings.long: Не выставляй всё так. Это были￥нужные расходы на расследование.

strings.en_src: The truth is...￥(It's cash, so nobody knows how much￥I spend.)
strings.long_src: Actually... (It's cash. If I keep￥quiet, nobody will know how much I￥spent.)
strings.long: Вообще-то... (Это наличные. Если￥промолчу, никто не узнает, сколько я￥потратил.)

strings.long_src: Did you say something?

strings.en_src: Don't keep checking your JUNKER ID,￥Gillian.
Men like him can be touchy.
Shouldn't you show it to Napoleon?

strings.long_src: You're right.
